record.rationale: JavaScript exception ABI explicitly links existing generated constructors and lazy native type getters; borrowed declared storage is copied by the actual generated class. Zero-argument getCaughtException uses synchronous host catch scope, with nesting restored. Original source misc catch/throw assertions pass; physical C++ binary mappings, machine code and native TLS are not certified. Actual UCB Any cancellation, CommandFailedException, Content isDocument/openStream and registered native CDocumentBuilder retain original defaults, callbacks and stream ownership. Original domtest stream QA passes. Real UCB/SimpleFileAccess providers, URI success/fallback service QA, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Core and SDK consume platform-neutral metadata and an injected exception ABI contract; only composition imports and initializes the browser implementation. Public comphelper WeakComponentImplHelper/Base and WeakImplHelper/Base retain distinct native namespaces, complete query/template/type-list contracts, shared actual UnoImplBase disposed field, late-listener/failure behavior and explicit destructor-only cleanup. Public container4 retains its own lazy DEFAULT and reverse COW snapshots, complete moves, matching-Context disposed removal and extra exceptionFunc overloads. The original catch-by-value Exception parameter is an actual base value while a single platform-neutral compiler catch scope preserves the original dynamic thrown value for zero-argument getCaughtException; only the injected host execution ABI remains browser-owned. Existing internal URE copies are unchanged. Physical virtual inheritance, mutex/native shared-memory interleavings, noexcept process termination and allocator/shutdown traces remain unqualified. Real metadata/property-bag, URI providers and complete DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unfinished.
